Dat  or directions COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS No. e  and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C-528 No. 1067 of 2025  Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Vikas Bahuguna, learned counsel for the Applicant.
2.
Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned A.G.A. for the State of Uttarakhand.

3. The present application under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, has been filed for quashing the charge-sheet dated 21.05.2025, the summoning order dated 21.06.2025 and the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 4401 of 2025, "State of Uttarakhand vs. Manveer",
for the offences punishable under Sections 504 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, pending before the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun.
In view of the matter, this Court is of the opinion that the presence of the Respondent No. 2 is required.

6. Issue notice to the Respondent No. 2.
7. Steps to be taken within a week.
8.
9. Counter affidavit, if any, may be filed in the meanwhile.

10. As an interim measure, it is directed that till the next date of listing, the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 4401 of 2025, "State of Uttarakhand vs. Manveer", for the offences punishable under Sections 504 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, pending before the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun, shall remain stayed.
( Ashish Naithani, J.) 10.07.2025 Shiksha C528/1067/2025 on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37386622/
